Celestial Companion.descriptionOnly: its spell resistance, 5 + half the caster level, against evil creatures' spells only, is told here

Minor Reversion.descriptionOnly: no path: its healing, 1d8 + 1 per caster level (+5 at most), is rolled at the table

Planar Aegis.descriptionOnly: no path: the attackers' damage, 3d6 + 1 per caster level (+20 at most), and its half damage from the chosen type are told at the table

Righteous Condemnation.descriptionOnly: no path: the –4 for each alignment component (–8 for two) on Intelligence-, Wisdom- and Charisma-based checks, and the +4 on the Will save against it, are those of the creatures that target the caster

Speak with Plane.descriptionOnly: no path: the plane's +20 (+15 for a demiplane, +2 or +4 by its traits) is its Will save against the spell

choices.label: Talisman of Reprieve: the Intelligence-, Wisdom- or Charisma-based skill

Talisman of Reprieve.descriptionOnly: on allies in its aura, who also ignore a plane's alignment penalties to Intelligence-, Wisdom- and Charisma-based checks
